changelogs: - Fixed admins not being able to open the dashboard even with the group set in the server.cfg. A plain add_principal only makes a player a member of the group, it does not create the matching ace object the check was looking for, and on QBCore the principals are named qbcore.admin instead of group.admin with only qbcore.god linked to group.admin. The script now registers its own ace object per group on start and accepts both spellings, so add_principal ... group.mod and /addpermission 1 mod both work
- Fixed the group check on the Permissions tab reporting 'not found' for brand new groups

- Fixed the 'Access denied for command add_ace' spam on every server start. FiveM checks add_ace against the resource that runs it and no resource holds that right by default, so the ace objects were never actually created. They are registered through msk_core now and the script checks up front whether it is allowed

- Requires msk_core 3.3.0 (MSK.AddRawAce, MSK.CanAddAce). Update msk_core along with this script and make sure your server.cfg has the msk_core ace lines, e.g. add_ace resource.msk_core command.add_ace allow
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, server/admin/permissions.lua, server/admin/boot.lua, server/admin/api.lua]
- Added an Ownership dialog to the Vehicles tab: switch an existing vehicle between player owned and job/society owned without deleting and giving it again
- Society owned means the owner column holds the job name, so ESX and msk_garage treat the vehicle as a faction vehicle and every member of the job can use it
- Switching back to a player works through the online player picker or a typed identifier for offline owners
- Society vehicles now show a JOB / SOCIETY badge in the vehicle browser
- Vehicle keys follow the owner: on every ownership change the old keys are removed and a new key is given to the new owner
- Added the permission 'vehicle.owner' (Change owner). group.admin has it automatically, your own groups have to be re-saved once in the Permissions tab
- Added the server console command _setvehowner <job|player> <jobName|identifier> <plate>

- Added an in-game Admin Dashboard (/givevehadmin, command name configurable): give, spawn, delete and manage vehicles visually - the old in-game commands have been replaced by it (the server console commands stay)
- Settings, permissions and item vehicles are now stored in the database (seeded once from your config on first start) and are live-editable in the dashboard without a restart

- Added a group & permission system: 9 rights (give / job-give / spawn / delete / move / browse / items / settings / permissions); group.admin always has everything, group.user can never open the dashboard, other groups are managed via a dashboard-group whitelist
- Added a vehicle browser with server-side search & pagination, built for large servers: filter by owner / player name / plate / model / type without ever loading the whole owned_vehicles table
- Every give now checks for a duplicate plate before insert and aborts with an error message instead of creating a broken entry
- Vehicle keys are now given automatically on give/spawn and removed on delete; the key script is auto-detected (msk_vehiclekeys / VehicleKeyChain / vehicles_keys) and toggleable in Settings

- msk_garage integration (only shown when msk_garage is running): pick a target garage when giving, filter the browser by garage, and move a vehicle from one garage to another; an empty target garage uses the msk_garage default garage for the vehicle's category
- The fuel system is now selectable from a dropdown (statebag / ox_fuel / msk_fuel / LegacyFuel / qs-fuelstations / native / custom)
- Added UI color customization with live preview and an editable brand tag, plus a language switch (DE / EN)
- Switched the license to LGPL-3.0 (same as msk_core)
- Fixed Command delveh
- Added Support for msk_vehiclekeys
